## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the center top button of the compact alarm clock

Task description: The target is the small alarm clock at the front right of the table, with a light-colored dial and dark case. Use the right arm to press the button at the center of its top.

Success criteria: The right gripper is closed and physically contacts the alarm clock within a small area near the top-center button and at approximately button height. Merely hovering above it is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- The alarm clock is partly outside the view on the right. Use the live observation to locate the top button and avoid pressing the edge of the clock face by mistake.
- Approach the button from above with the fingertips of the closed gripper in small steps, reducing sideways contact with the clock housing. Use a light touch at contact and avoid pressing deeply or continuously.
